title: Feature Registry, Eligibility API, and Automated Leakage Gate
mission: Register every feature and enforce production/research/diagnostic eligibility automatically before any model fit.
steps: Create feature registry with source, formula, unit, availability, fit scope, role and status.
Implement feature materialization API requiring target date/cutoff/frame.
Implement denylist patterns for target/residual/error/outcome-derived fields.
Reject full-history normalization/PCA/text models outside folds.
Generate feature manifests and hashes for every matrix.
tests: Inject forbidden fields and prove rejection
acceptance: No training job can run without a passing feature manifest
failure: Unknown feature defaults to blocked, not allowed
